Hi Lena — appreciate the checklist. Quick summary and proposal below so everyone has the same expectations.

Proposed MAP & timing (high level):
- Today (Mar 18): Redwood sends updated MAP + SOW with minor clarifications — attached (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf, SOW_Attachment_A.docx).
- Mar 19–22: Procurement + legal exchange window for redlines/questions. Aim to resolve non-material terms within 3 business days.
- Mar 23–29: Signature window. If both teams push for DocuSign between Mar 24–28 we can target an operational start date of Apr 1 (internal provisioning + onboarding).

Key constraints from our side:
- Legal needs a final SOW to start redlines; minor language tweaks are typically cleared in 48–72 hours. Substantive edits (data residency, indemnity changes) add time.
- Procurement: Ben will confirm PO lead time, but plan for 5–7 business days after signed SOW for billing/PO processing if you require a PO.
- Onboarding: With DocuSign complete, infra provisioning and initial kickoff can be done in ~3 business days for our standard private deployments.

Action items for you: please confirm whether FinServe requires a countersignature by a specific role (CPO/CFO) and whether a PO will be raised pre- or post-signature. Also confirm whether the security addendum needs to be executed as a separate exhibit.

Attachments: [Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (pdf), SOW_Attachment_A.docx (docx)]

If that timeline looks okay I will loop Evelyn for the formal legal pass and Ben will confirm procurement timelines.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Priyom — quick procurement notes from my side (copied below for the FinServe thread once we have alignment):

- Typical PO lead time from enterprise FinServe-sized customers is 5–7 business days after they issue the PO to accounting. If the customer needs a PO before we sign, that will push the signature date out (they often request pre-sign PO for internal approvals).
- Billing terms: Redwood standard is Net 30 from invoice unless we agreed otherwise in the SOW. Any changes will need deal-desk approval and may affect the payment start date.
- If FinServe requires a vendor form or W9, ask them to attach to the DocuSign envelope to avoid back-and-forth post-signature.

I can prepare a short procurement note for Lena summarizing these timelines so expectations are clear.

Hi all — I did a quick pass on the SOW and attached a one-page redline summary. High-level legal position below: 

- We can accept the SOW as drafted with minor edits. The items that could delay signature are changes to indemnity caps, data residency obligations, or any deletion of our standard limitation of liability language.
- If FinServe provides only a standard procurement checklist and no material contractual redlines, we should be able to finish legal review within 48–72 hours once we receive final SOW back.
- Signature authority: VP, Legal (myself) can countersign commercial SOWs up to $500k total contract value; anything above that requires General Counsel approval which may add 2–3 business days. Please confirm estimated TCV.

Recommended schedule from Legal:
- If DocuSign envelope is sent by Mar 24: target countersign by Mar 26–29.
- If the envelope slips past Mar 24, earliest feasible countersign moves to Apr 5 due to travel schedules across the legal team.

Attachment: [Legal_Redlines_v1.pdf (pdf)]

Evelyn Hart
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
